{{translated title}} ---- (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンクイズパズルランド　ピカチュウの{{ruby|宝|たから}}さがし}}''' ''Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu's Treasure Hunt'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] composed by [[Hiroshi Takase]] and illustrated by [[Kemon Kawamoto]]. It is serialized in the ''{{OBP|Pokémon Fan|Japan}}'' magazine, with the first chapter published in the issue 82, released on February 28, 2023. The manga utilizes quizzes and puzzles as a method of storytelling. ==Chapters== {| class="roundtable c" style="background:#{{colorschemelight|Paldea}}; border:3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Paldea}}" !
